title: Fable 5 Review of Intent codebase
objective: A comprehensive architectural and design/implementation audit of Intent by Fable 5. Output: confirmed findings in design.md (falsifiable claims with file:line evidence) and proposed changes articulated as sized work packages in this steel thread. WPs execute only after user adjudication at the review gate.
context: The review doubles as the first deliberate MFIC exercise (see ST0041): mechanical sweep coverage, falsifiable findings, reviewer independence from producing sessions, human review gate as the control. Methodology, coverage map, and finding format live in design.md. Observations about which MFIC axes held or leaked are recorded in impl.md and harvested into ST0041.
body:
## LLM Preamble

I want to spend a cycle and get Fable to do a comprehensive architectural review and design/implementation audit of Intent. The review should propose any necessary changes to the system and articulate them as work packages here in this steel thread. Once reviewed, we will execute the WPs.

## Related Steel Threads

- ST0041 -- MFIC exploration; this review is its empirical test bed
- ST0034/ST0035 -- produced most of the surface under review (rules, critics, canon, hooks)
